baseline.note: Release 461 is the already-proven schema baseline. Historical files in migrations/dev are provenance only and are never replayed by this canonical stream.

migrations.description: Bootstrap the forward-only canonical migration proof authority used alongside Cloudflare D1's native d1_migrations ledger.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only. Restore the pre-migration D1 backup if required, or repair with a new numbered migration. Never edit or replay this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add migration-owned operational retention archive review and audited safe-recovery evidence for Update 2.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only. Restore the pre-migration D1 backup if required, or repair retention/recovery authorities with a new numbered migration. Never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add scheduled Storefront merchandising rules and the cross-module Creative-to-Storefront business pipeline spine.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive tables. Disable rules or archive pipeline rows for logical rollback; restore the pre-migration D1 backup only for unrecoverable schema integrity failure.

migrations.description: Make Product publication hard-readiness migration-owned and add fail-closed SEO/readiness guards for Release 465 Build 1.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only. Unpublish affected Products before any corrective migration; repair or replace Release 465 publication triggers only with a new numbered migration. Never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add a shared workshop-process catalog and one reviewed primary process assignment for each Tool or Supply inventory item.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive tables. Clear or reassign process links for logical rollback; repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration and never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Correct the Release 465 activation trigger so legacy active Products can repair media safely while preserving publication-boundary and no-degradation guards.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only trigger correction. If the guard semantics require further repair, add a new numbered migration; never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add explicit admin-owned launch-set remediation review metadata: owner, status, due note, official recheck evidence and completion evidence.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive table. Logical rollback leaves Product/Inventory facts untouched; archive or supersede remediation metadata as needed. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration and never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Extend the existing inventory_processes workshop taxonomy for the full multi-discipline maker/manufacturing capability set while preserving all Build 156 process keys and reviewed Tool/Supply assignments.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only reference-taxonomy expansion. Existing process keys and inventory assignments remain intact. Correct taxonomy defects only with a new numbered migration; never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add reviewed workshop capability profiles linked to canonical process keys, with source notes, explicit unknown/measured constraint state, customer-supplied assessment policy, proof/sample policy and public/admin routing.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive table. Hide or hold profiles for logical rollback; correct facts only through reviewed admin updates or a new numbered migration. Never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Enrich the existing custom_requests authority with structured quantity, project intent, intended use, organisation/event context, supplied-item, material/finish, personalization, capability preference, size/tolerance and help-me-choose fields.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive columns and indexes. Existing requests and status/quote/order journeys remain intact. Correct schema defects only with a new numbered migration; never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add staff-reviewed manufacturing triage and ordered candidate-process route proposals linked to existing custom_requests and canonical inventory_processes.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive tables. Logical rollback archives/clears triage and candidate-route evidence only; customer requests and canonical process identity remain intact. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add ordered multi-process Creative Project operation plans, explicit operation dependencies and planned Inventory resource references while preserving Creative Process, Inventory and CAIP ownership.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive tables. Logical rollback retires operation plans or removes planning-only dependency/resource links; actual Creative Process events, Inventory movements, CAIP media and Finance records remain untouched. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add versioned private Custom Work proof records and append-only approval/change-request event history with optional Packaging-version and customer-safe stage-photo references.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive tables. Logical rollback supersedes/expires proof versions while retaining audit history; Packaging, CAIP/media, Custom Work and publication authorities remain independently owned. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add explicit prototype/sample/production maturity lifecycle and append-only transition evidence over existing Creative Process, Custom Work and Build 213 proof authorities.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive tables. Logical rollback records a superseding lifecycle transition; never delete failed prototype or approval history. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Extend existing Custom Work quote drafts with structured small-batch/corporate/event assumptions and quantity tiers while retaining existing quote revisions, line items, payment gates and order drafts.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive tables. Logical rollback stops using/supersedes batch quote terms and tiers; existing quote drafts, revisions, line items, payment and order authorities remain intact. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Extend existing Custom Work with customer-supplied item identity, append-only suitability reviews, links to existing intake/post-work media evidence, and explicit limitation acknowledgement without duplicating triage or media authorities.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive tables. Logical rollback stops creating new supplied-item records/reviews/acknowledgements while retaining existing evidence history. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add nullable Creative Project manufacturing source evidence for operation-level time, direct-cost components, failed prototypes and actual produced/accepted quantities while preserving Inventory and Finance/Accounting ownership.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive table. Void incorrect evidence rows while retaining history; do not rewrite Inventory or Finance/Accounting facts. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add versioned reviewed manufacturing job-traveler snapshots and append-only traveler events over existing Custom Request, Creative Project, proof/sample, operation/resource, supplied-item and Packaging/handoff authorities.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive traveler evidence. Void or supersede traveler versions for logical rollback; source authorities remain untouched. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration and never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add reviewed production-run outcome evidence with per-operation timestamps/outcomes, QA checks, links to existing Inventory postings, and finished-inventory/order handoff references while preserving Inventory and Finance/Accounting ownership.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive evidence tables. Void incorrect reviewed runs and record a corrected run; do not rewrite Inventory movements, order authority or Finance/Accounting facts. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add a reviewed internal Workshop Knowledge Library linking source-backed material/tool Inventory identities, canonical workshop processes, observed settings, constraints/outcomes, Creative Project provenance and reference-only evidence.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive knowledge tables. Void incorrect reviewed knowledge entries while retaining provenance; never rewrite source Creative Project, Inventory, process or media authorities. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add reviewed Project-to-Knowledge promotion with immutable recipe version snapshots, exact Creative Project/operation provenance, canonical process/Inventory identities, observed settings, failure history and explicit supersession.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive recipe history. Supersede or void incorrect recipe versions while retaining provenance; never rewrite source Creative Project, Inventory, process or media authorities. Repair schema defects only with a new numbered migration.

migrations.description: Close the measured 21/22 public capability-profile coverage gap by adding one reviewed Photography & Content profile for the existing canonical photography-content process; no schema change or parallel taxonomy.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only reference-data extension. Correct through the existing Build 209 reviewed capability authority or a new forward migration; never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add five owner-authorized editable 2 × 2 inch Soap Cupcake label system templates (Sweet Orange, Charcoal, Oatmeal & Goat Milk, Sea Breeze, Lavender Dream) to the existing Packaging authority without changing existing projects.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive reference templates. Deactivate or supersede a template for logical rollback; do not rewrite existing Packaging projects. Correct template facts with a later numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add explicit operator-owned Creative Process material-event resource identity links to existing Supply/Tool Inventory, with optional existing operation context and no stock movement.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive reference table. Remove incorrect identity-link rows through the reviewed operator workflow; never rewrite Inventory movement or Creative Process history. Repair schema defects only with a later numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add workstation-role and optional parent-station metadata over the existing canonical inventory_processes and inventory_process_assignments authorities, without creating a parallel category taxonomy.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive role table. Clear or correct workstation-role/parent links for logical rollback; existing Inventory rows and canonical process assignments remain authoritative and untouched. Repair schema defects only with a later numbered migration.

migrations.description: Allow an associated Inventory Tool/Supply to link to zero, one or many workstation Tool rows while retaining one primary inventory_process/category assignment and preserving migration 0025 single-station relationships.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive membership table. Logical rollback is to clear inventory_workstation_memberships; migration 0025 role/category authority remains intact. Do not drop the table in place—repair only with a later numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add one Creative Process maker-story profile per existing Creative Project plus reference-only links to canonical workstation Tool inventory, while retaining CAIP private media/evidence and Content Studio review-first publication authorities.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive profile/reference tables. Logical rollback clears or revises maker-story metadata and workstation references only; never delete or rewrite source Creative Project, Inventory, CAIP media, Content Studio or publication evidence. Repair defects only with a later numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add the All Stations canonical Inventory process and an independent current physical workstation-location pointer for tools and supplies. Production promotion reproof retains the exact applied migration bytes.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive taxonomy row and location table. Logical rollback clears inventory_current_locations and stops assigning All Stations; retain the schema and repair defects only with a later numbered migration.

migrations.description: Add Development Etsy OAuth owner/shop identity metadata so the numeric shop ID is discovered after authenticated OAuth instead of requiring a fourth Cloudflare variable; listing writes remain locked. Build 350 requests Development-first canonical schema reproof before Production promotion.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only additive safe metadata table. Disconnect destroys local token material and marks the safe shop metadata disconnected. Repair OAuth/shop identity defects only with a later numbered migration; never edit this migration after Development application.

migrations.description: Add operator-requested Jewelry & Forge Work and Auto Detailing categories to the existing canonical inventory_processes workstation/category authority without changing existing Inventory assignments.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only reference-data extension. Existing categories and assignments remain intact. Reassign items through Inventory Operations for logical rollback; correct taxonomy facts only with a later numbered migration.

migrations.description: Append-only per-operation execution status transitions, accountable manual work time and linked genuine project milestones, with authenticated actor and index-backed dependency checks.
migrations.recovery: Stop new work-order writes and retain append-only rows for audit. Repair with a new forward-only correction migration; never drop existing business history, Inventory, Creative Process, or CAIP data.

migrations.description: Operator-owned project material reservations and partial releases atomically reflected in the canonical stock reserved_quantity and site_inventory_movements; item identity, actual posts and supplier lots remain source owned.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only; release outstanding reservations through the operator API. Do not delete records or reset canonical stock by dropping the table. Use later compensating migration for corrections.

migrations.description: Add operator-confirmed UTC production resource calendar and project deadline events; DB half-open overlap constraints, explicit maintenance acknowledgement, reviewed conflict overrides, and immutable cancellation history.
migrations.recovery: Forward-only ledger. Cancel active entries through Admin to free calendar windows; preserve all rows and audit history. Repair future defects with a new numbered migration rather than editing applied SQL.

migrations.description: Append-only staff commission review decisions linked to existing Custom Requests, quote drafts/revisions, payment-request drafts, actual customer proof approvals, job drafts, manufacturing project identity and explicitly approved progress on active private order links.
migrations.recovery: Preserve immutable commission evidence and all original quote/proof/payment/order records. Append compensating staff decisions; repair future defects through new forward-only migration.

migrations.description: Append-only source-linked operator review of cross-project Finance, Accounting, materials, labour, tax and payment reconciliation evidence; no financial posting, and immutable history.
migrations.recovery: Append follow-up review events; preserve all financial source records and repair schema through a new forward-only migration.

migrations.description: Atomic source-linked immutable user-scoped write receipts for explicitly integrated commission decisions, Finance reviews, and project material reserve/release, with payload digest and request-key identity.
migrations.recovery: Preserve all business and receipt rows. A successful source operation and receipt commit atomically; do not delete receipts or regenerate. Add future compensating migrations for defects.

migrations.description: Add durable atomic receipts for work-order execution and resource calendar bookings, preserving Build 385 immutable receipt history and source-authored rows.
migrations.recovery: Disable new Build 386 writes while preserving all work-order, calendar and receipt records; repair via a later forward-only migration and never rewrite existing receipts.

migrations.description: Atomic operator-confirmed Tool/Supply count and unit correction with HST estimate, movement and immutable actor-bound source receipt.
migrations.recovery: Preserve existing stock data, movement rows, tax estimates and receipts. Repair via a later forward-only migration; no destructive rollback.

migrations.description: Additive product-bound R2 video references with private-review by default, bounded one-video uploads and explicit publication review.
migrations.recovery: Preserve every original product, image, attachment and object. Correct via a forward-only migration; never drop existing media records.

migrations.description: Immutable private CAD/CAM/reference originals with exact project revision ancestry, append-only human reviews and explicit canonical project-output design lineage.
migrations.recovery: Disable Build 444 writes but retain the immutable revision, review and output lineage records and private R2 originals. Correct future defects only with a forward-only compensating migration; do not delete files or reset project history.

migrations.description: Additive per-project BOM with process, supplier-lot and workstation references plus unique immutable classifications of actual canonical Inventory posting receipts; no competing stock authority.
migrations.recovery: Preserve every BOM line, canonical Inventory posting and classified actual-use receipt. Disable new Build 445 writes and correct forward only; never recalculate or overwrite physical stock or supplier lot balances.

migrations.description: Immutable executions of reviewed traveler steps; operator pause/resume, cure/checklist, equipment/substitution and unique source-linked actual Work Order time and Creative Process evidence.
migrations.recovery: Disable new guided execution writes, retaining all history; correct forward only. Never rewrite traveler snapshots, actual Work Order time, Inventory, media or source project plans.

migrations.description: Immutable maker quality attempts, failed/reworked lineage, independent sale-safety reviews, approved Product handoffs and unique source-only Inventory recovery receipts; no stock or provider writes.
migrations.recovery: Retain all failed and approved quality history and canonical Inventory receipts. To supersede any decision append another review. Correct schema forward only; never reclassify material recovery by adding stock or rewriting historical attempts.

migrations.description: Immutable human Tool inspection and exact calendar conflict approvals with additive SQLite booking guards for unsafe/out-of-service equipment, maintenance blocks and unreviewed shared-Tool overlaps. Preserve canonical multi-workstation memberships, location, lifecycle and calendar authorities.
migrations.recovery: Disable Build 448 review writes if necessary; preserve approved/declined decisions and inspections. Do not delete calendar history, Inventory, lifecycle records or old traveler steps. Correct defects with a new forward-only migration and human review.

migrations.description: Immutable CAD costing assumptions and optional per-item pricing scenarios that reconcile actual canonical Inventory, Work Order labour, production evidence, BOM plan and quality attempts without duplicate costs, accounting posts, Product pricing or revenue.
migrations.recovery: Retain every human cost review and source posting. Stop new costing reviews or supersede a scenario with a later review. Repair defects only with a new forward-only migration; never change physical Inventory, accounting, payment or sales authorities.

migrations.description: Unique physical serials and variants linked to human-approved QA and canonical Product stock, append-only cross-channel hold/release/paid-sale evidence, checkout protection against duplicate allocations and factual kit-component order-line links. No duplicate stock or provider posting.
migrations.recovery: Preserve serials, QA lineage, stock commitments and immutable claims. Release an unused channel hold with a new receipt; sold units require real return/restock review in a future workflow. Repair schema forward-only and never fabricate component use.

migrations.description: Source-linked maker photography and video storyboard revisions with true Creative Project and canonical Product provenance, exact-media consent for public candidates, private learning/failure stories and append-only human editorial review. No R2 copies, product-gallery writes or provider publication.
migrations.recovery: Retain private revisions, frames, human notes and original media. Create a superseding revision or HOLD review when consent or rights change; make repairs in a forward-only migration and never infer live public permission from candidate status.

migrations.description: Private append-only commission change/cost impact and maker-completion reviews linked to actual customer-approved proof, quote revisions, commission cost reviews, completed traveler steps, quality-accepted finished pieces and source order status. Never creates a customer approval, payment settlement, inventory posting or delivered-order claim.
migrations.recovery: Retain genuine source approvals, cost review and operator completion receipts; record an explicit later delivery HOLD or corrected review. Use forward-only fixes, never rewrite quote, payment, media or stock authorities.
